name: Le Conte barrel cactus
desc: Le Conte barrel cactus (Ferocactus cylindraceus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 183 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ferocactus cylindraceus is a species of barrel cactus which is known by several common names, including California barrel cactus, Desert barrel cactus, compass barrel cactus, and miner's compass.
